note: The CMYK frame is accepted, so the decoder proceeds with attacker-controlled component geometry.
The maximum vertical sampling factor is derived from the supplied file, which influences the later resample selection.
The decoder expands the component width into MCU-sized storage based on the parsed sampling factors.
For a large image width, the low-resolution width remains large, increasing the number of resampler iterations and the amount of written output.
A 2x2 sampling ratio selects the HV special-case kernel, which expands each low-resolution sample into four output pixels.
The HV resampler emits multiple output pixels per input sample; if the upstream geometry underestimates the destination row size, these indexed writes can run past the end of the buffer.
